moments.author: Clément Delangue
moments.quote: Hugging Face will remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem... Nvidia compute will not be required to build on or deploy through Hugging Face.
moments.why: His reassurance following Nvidia’s $12.93B acquisition announcement is going viral among devs and AI enthusiasts.

moments.author: Haircut
moments.quote: At $12.9B Nvidia is paying 86x revenue... hugging face told nvidia no at $7B last year.
moments.why: Deep-market breakdown on the Nvidia–Hugging Face deal sparked lots of engagement among tech-investor circles.
